title: Chipotle IQ trivia game returns Aug. 18: How to get $1 million in free food and a new Silver Ticket Sweepstakes
excerpt: Your burrito order history has prepared you for this moment.
content_html:
TL;DR: Chipotle IQ returns Aug. 18-20, giving Chipotle Rewards members the chance to win BOGO entrée codes, free Cilantro Lime Sauce, free Queso Blanco, and Rewards points by testing their Chipotle knowledge. New this year: a Silver Ticket Sweepstakes offering 53 players free burritos for a year, plus a limited-edition physical trivia card game.

Chipotle is bringing back Chipotle IQ, its trivia game that lets Chipotle Rewards members test their knowledge of the brand for a shot at free food.

From Aug. 18-20, players can win BOGO entrée codes, free Cilantro Lime Sauce, free Queso Blanco, and Rewards points — with more than $1 million in prizes up for grabs across the three days.

Mashable Top Stories

You May Also Like

How it works

Hop on Chipotle IQ and sign in with the email tied to your Rewards account. Each hour between 6 a.m. and 5:59 p.m. PT, the game runs a round of five multiple-choice and true-or-false questions about Chipotle's ingredients, cooking methods, and community engagement.

The first 8,000 players each hour to get a perfect score win a food reward — there are 5,000 BOGO offers, 1,500 free sauce offers, and 1,500 free queso offers up for grabs hourly. Score 4 out of 5, and you'll still walk away with 25 Rewards points, and even a perfect score without a food prize nets you 50 bonus points. You can only play once per day, so pace yourself.

What's new

The big new addition this year is the Silver Ticket Sweepstakes. Players who nail a perfect score might get randomly picked to receive a Silver Ticket, which unlocks a bonus question. Answer it right, and you win free burritos for an entire year — only 53 people can qualify for the free burritos. There's also a new Daily Streaks feature that rewards fans with bonus points and exclusive badges for playing multiple days in a row.

Consider Chipotle IQ your most delicious pop quiz of the summer.

Chipotle 正在重新推出 Chipotle IQ，这是一款问答游戏，让 Chipotle Rewards 会员可以测试自己对该品牌的了解程度，从而有机会获得免费食物。

从 8 月 18 日至 20 日，玩家可以赢取 BOGO 主菜代码、免费香菜青柠酱、免费 Queso Blanco 和奖励积分，三天内将有超过 100 万美元的奖品可供争夺。

它是如何运作的

跳上 Chipotle IQ 并使用与您的奖励帐户绑定的电子邮件登录。 早上 6 点之间每小时一次 下午 5:59 PT，游戏运行一轮五轮多项选择题和对错题，内容涉及 Chipotle 的原料、烹饪方法和社区参与度。

每小时获得满分的前 8,000 名玩家将赢得食物奖励——每小时有 5,000 个 BOGO 优惠、1,500 个免费酱汁优惠和 1,500 个免费 queso 优惠可供争夺。 满分 5 分，得 4 分，您仍将获得 25 点奖励积分，即使是满分但没有食物奖励，您也能获得 50 点奖励积分。 您每天只能玩一次，所以请调整自己的节奏。

什么是新的

今年新增的一大亮点是银票抽奖活动。 获得满分的玩家可能会被随机挑选获得一张银票，这将解锁一个奖励问题。 如果回答正确，您将赢得一整年的免费墨西哥卷饼——只有 53 人有资格获得免费墨西哥卷饼。 还有一个新的“每日连胜”功能，可以为连续多天玩游戏的粉丝奖励积分和专属徽章。

将 Chipotle IQ 视为您夏季最美味的流行测验。
